title: Calciopoli: champions to Serie B, then world champions
checked: 2005-06 table as played: Juve 91, Milan 88, Inter 76, Fiorentina 74, Roma 69, Lazio 62 with W/D/L/GD; after penalties Inter 76, Roma 69, Milan 58 (Wikipedia 2005-06 Serie A). Juve won it on 14 May 2006; Moggi resigned ('They killed my soul') (Wikipedia Calciopoli). Wiretaps of calls between Moggi and referee designators Bergamo and Pairetto (Wikipedia, Bleacher Report Naples trial summary, Footballpost). 14 Jul 2006 first verdict: Juve relegated, 2004-05 title revoked (Wikipedia, Sky); appeal 25 Jul; 26 Jul Inter declared 2005-06 champions; 26 Oct final: Juve -9 in Serie B, Milan -8, Fiorentina -15, Lazio -3, Reggina -11 (Wikipedia, Sky, SI). 2004-05 left unassigned (Wikipedia, SI). Five Juve players in Italy's squad: Buffon, Cannavaro, Zambrotta, Camoranesi, Del Piero (Juventus.com, 11v11). Final 9 Jul 2006 Berlin: Zidane penalty 7', Materazzi header from a Pirlo corner 19', Zidane sent off for the headbutt in extra time, 5-3 on penalties, Trezeguet (a Juve player) hit the bar, Grosso scored the winner (Wikipedia final, FIFA). Kits: Italy blue, France all white (OneIndia/Reuters 6 Jul 2006). Cannavaro 2006 Ballon d'Or (Wikipedia 2006 Ballon d'Or; well documented). Juve won Serie B 2006-07 (Wikipedia, Footballpost). Moggi: FIGC lifetime ban 2011, confirmed 2017; criminal case ended in 2015, partly acquitted and partly time-barred (Wikipedia, Sky). Gameplay: Materazzi's header recreated (Pirlo corner, Vieira beaten; corner side not in sources, set from the right); Grosso's penalty shown as a scored penalty only (placement not in sources). Spec: gamecap/specs/wc2006-final.json. lines.text: Summer 2006. Juventus are champions of Italy. Weeks later, they're in Serie B, and their players win the World Cup.
lines.say: Summer two thousand and six. Yooventus are champions of Italy. Weeks later, they're in Seree B, and their players win the World Cup.

lines.text: On the pitch, Juve won the 2005-06 league with ninety-one points, three clear of Milan.
lines.say: On the pitch, Yoovay won the twenty oh five, oh six league with ninety-one points, three clear of Milan.

lines.text: Then police phone taps came out. Juve's boss Luciano Moggi, on the line to the men who picked the referees.
lines.say: Then police phone taps came out. Yoovay's boss, Loochahno Moji, on the line to the men who picked the referees.

scene.headline: Phone taps rock Italian football
scene.standfirst: Intercepted calls show Juventus general manager Luciano Moggi talking to the officials who chose Serie A referees.

lines.text: Moggi quit, days after the title party. His words: they killed my soul.
lines.say: Moji quit, days after the title party. His words: they killed my soul.

lines.text: July. The verdict. Juventus were relegated, and stripped of two titles.
lines.say: July. The verdict. Yooventus were relegated, and stripped of two titles.

lines.text: The 2005 title went to nobody. The 2006 one was handed to Inter, who'd finished fifteen points behind.
lines.say: The twenty oh five title went to nobody. The twenty oh six one was handed to Inter, who'd finished fifteen points behind.

lines.text: Their penalty in Serie B started at thirty points, was cut to seventeen, then finally to nine.
lines.say: Their penalty in Seree B started at thirty points, was cut to seventeen, then finally to nine.

lines.text: Milan, Fiorentina, Lazio and Reggina lost points too, but stayed up.
lines.say: Milan, Feeorenteena, Latseeoh and Rejeena lost points too, but stayed up.

lines.text: The twist? Italy were at the World Cup in Germany, with five Juve players.
lines.say: The twist? Italy were at the World Cup in Germany, with five Yoovay players.

lines.text: The final, Berlin. Zidane scores a penalty. Then Materazzi heads in Pirlo's corner. One-one.
lines.say: The final, Berlin. Zeedan scores a penalty. Then Materatsee heads in Peerlo's corner. One, one.

lines.text: Extra time. Zidane headbutts Materazzi, and he's sent off in his last ever game.
lines.say: Extra time. Zeedan headbutts Materatsee, and he's sent off in his last ever game.

lines.text: Penalties. Trezeguet, a Juventus striker, hits the bar. Grosso scores. Italy are world champions.
lines.say: Penalties. Trezegay, a Yooventus striker, hits the bar. Grosso scores. Italy are world champions.

lines.text: Cannavaro lifted the trophy, then left for Real Madrid, and won the Ballon d'Or.
lines.say: Kannahvaroh lifted the trophy, then left for Rayal Madrid, and won the Ballon d'Or.

lines.text: Buffon and Del Piero stayed. Juve won Serie B at the first attempt. Moggi was banned from football for life.
lines.say: Boofon and Del Pyairo stayed. Yoovay won Seree B at the first attempt. Moji was banned from football for life.
